visual_result: All three page regions are readable. The new contract page, navigation entry, and related links are visible.
repository_check: The required repository hook passed Ruff, ty, 393 tests, and strict MkDocs for this source content.

review_concerns.duplication: P08 and P09 use one set of authored control records. Record owns common numeric and immutability rules.
review_concerns.complexity: Each concrete control has one short validation method. No service dispatch or native state is added.
review_concerns.ownership: Shared contracts own names, modes, and units. Package owners retain geometry, imported data, and publication.
review_concerns.behavior_and_failures: Focused tests cover round trips, rate and phase mismatches, shut zero rates, invalid names, and nonfinite values.
review_concerns.evidence: The browser record reports three pages and 13 successful local links. Screenshots were inspected by the lead.

limits: The review covers desktop page regions at 1440 by 1050.
No native application or simulator acceptance is claimed.
